title: Research paper workflow
promise: Collect sources, write in plain text, format the citations and export a clean PDF.
time: Ongoing; set it up in about 2 hours
audience: Students, academics and anyone who cites things

steps.title: Collect and annotate sources
steps.why: Zotero saves references from the browser, stores the PDFs and keeps your notes attached to them.

steps.title: Write the draft
steps.why: Obsidian makes it easy to link notes and write in Markdown, which converts cleanly to almost any other format.

steps.title: Format citations and convert
steps.why: Pandoc turns Markdown into a Word or OpenDocument file and formats citations from your Zotero export. It is a command-line tool with a learning curve.

steps.title: Finish the layout and export
steps.why: LibreOffice Writer handles page numbers, headings and the final PDF export, with no subscription.
